## c8f4bbd87f63

**Reproduced canonical-profile collapse.** The canonical rule copies arbitrary nonzero values from the upper-left 3×3 template around every external color-2 anchor. The generator hardcodes a color-2 center and color-3 arms. Its validator accepts only 1 of 5 canonical pairs; the other four use template values 4, 5, 6, or 7, and one canonical template even has color 5 at the center.

The exact canonical color-4 input, canonical Racket output, a hardcoded-color-3 rival, eight differing cells, all five canonical validator results, and a 600-draw production probe are in `checks/audit/c8f4bbd87f63/analysis.json`; the Racket receipt is `checks/audit/c8f4bbd87f63/racket.json`. Across 600 generated inputs, the only observed template arm color was 3. Generator SHA-256: `5f8f768f25ec567d49ebb59c89cf10afe201de96b419cea594b49a7806967a01`; rule hash: `54abfbcb7aae`.

The exact input is canonical but fails the current validator, so it is outside the documented/generated domain only because the implementation narrowed the task incorrectly. A learner can fit every generated lesson with “always stamp color 3,” which fails canonical color variants. Recommended resolution: generate arbitrary template values/patterns from the canonical grammar and validate the actual template rather than fixed colors. No audit-target files were changed.

## c8f4bbd87f63

**Reproduced canonical-domain defect — template arm color is incorrectly hard-coded to 3.** The audited source is `generators/c8f4bbd87f63/generator.py` at SHA-256 `5f8f768f25ec567d49ebb59c89cf10afe201de96b419cea594b49a7806967a01`; the executed rule hash is `54abfbcb7aae`. Its generator and `self_check` require color-3 template arms, although the canonical Racket transformation copies whatever nonzero arm values occur in the 3×3 template.

Fresh checks found that only 1/5 canonical labeled pairs passes the current validator. Across 600 production draws (easy/medium/hard, seeds and sample indices 0–199), the only generated arm color was 3. A lawful canonical-style color-4 template is rejected by `self_check`, while the selected Racket rule copies color 4 to eight cells where the hard-coded-color-3 rival writes 3. This is actionable distribution/validator drift, not a proposed authority change.

Reproducer and exact outputs: `checks/audit/c8f4bbd87f63/input.json`, `checks/audit/c8f4bbd87f63/racket.json`, and `checks/audit/c8f4bbd87f63/analysis.json`. The source-bound analysis can be regenerated with `checks/audit/reproduce_current.py`. I did not edit this audit target.
